blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Affordable snapshot hyperspectral cameras capture spectral images in a single exposure but suffer from limited spatial resolution and sensor noise. Low-cost RGB cameras provide fine visible details to guide NIR reconstruction, but introduce spatially varying cross-camera misalignment. Supervised fusion methods require relatively large datasets of clean, high-resolution hyperspectral images, are sensitive to sensor noise, and generalize poorly across new sensors. We introduce SHARPnP, an interpretable, flexible framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements without clean references. We adapt a pretrained registration model via a cross-view loss backpropagated through a fixed plug-and-play fusion module. Temporal and recorrupted pairs enable reference-free self-supervision on noisy inputs. At test time, we calibrate cross-camera radiometry and refine alignment. Plug-and-play fusion employs sequential three-band denoising. On the REAL benchmark, SHARPnP outperforms supervised fusion baselines at $4\times$, $8\times$, and $16\times$ on clean inputs and at $4\times$ under Gaussian noise ($σ=5/255, 10/255$). On native RGB-HSI snapshot measurements, it reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands, beyond the conventional 31-band VIS setting, without high-resolution references.
blocks.zh: 负担得起的快照超光谱相机在一次照射中捕获光谱图像,但空间分辨率和传感器噪音有限。 低成本的RGB相机提供了细微的可见细节来指导国家清单报告重建,但引入了空间相差相机错配. 被监督的聚变方法需要相对较大的数据集来提供干净高分辨率的超光谱图像,对传感器噪声很敏感,对新传感器的概括性差. 我们引入了SHARPnP, 一种可解释的,灵活的框架 组合注册和重建 RGB 制导的超光谱超分辨率 从响亮的,不相通的测量 没有干净的参考。 我们通过一个固定的插座和游戏聚变模块,通过交叉视差回放来调整一个预先训练过的注册模型. Timor and recorpressed pairs 可以在噪音输入上实现无参考自控. 在测试时间,我们校正了相机的相机辐射测量,并完善了对接. 插管和游戏聚变采用相继三波段去声. 在实际基准上,SHARPnP在监督核聚变基线方面表现优于4美元、8美元和16美元,用于清洁投入,在高斯噪音下达到4美元(σ=5/255,10/255美元)。 在原生的RGB-HSI快照测量上,它重建了所有51个VIS-NIR波段,超出了传统的31波段VIS设置,没有高分辨率的参考.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Compact snapshot hyperspectral imaging (HSI) captures dense spectral measurements in a single exposure, enabling material characterization in dynamic scenes [ 18 ] . Materials that look alike in RGB can have distinct spectral signatures, which are useful in applications such as robotic inspection, precision agriculture, waste sorting, nondestructive testing, heritage imaging, gas detection, and biomedicine [ 10 , 21 , 22 , 4 , 20 , 26 ] . Low-cost snapshot sensors trade spatial resolution and signal-to-noise ratio for rich spectral information and acquisition speed, obscuring fine structures.
blocks.zh: 压缩快照超光谱成像(HSI)在一次接触中捕捉到密集光谱测量,使材料在动态场景中具有特性[18]. 在RGB中外观相似的材料可以有明显的光谱特征,这些特征在机器人检查,精准农业,废物分类,无损测试,遗产成像,气体检测,生物医学等应用中有用[10,21,22,4,20,26]. 低成本快照传感器对丰富的光谱信息和获取速度进行空间分辨率和信号与噪声比交易,模糊了精细的结构.

blocks.en:
RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR) uses a separate relatively high-resolution camera to recover spatial detail [ 11 , 9 ] . On ground-level, depth-dependent parallax and occlusions complicate cross-camera alignment, while differences in sensor response and HSI noise make it harder to match pixel correspondences.
Misaligned guidance can introduce spurious edges, while suppressing guidance indiscriminately leaves the reconstruction blurred [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
RGB制导的超光谱超分辨率(HSR)使用单独的相对高分辨率相机来回收空间细节[11,9]. 在地面层面,深度依赖的抛物和隐蔽使跨相机对齐复杂化,而传感器反应和HSI噪声的差异使得像素对应更加难.
错误的引导可以引入虚假的边缘,同时不加区别地压制引导使得重建变得模糊 [9].

blocks.en:
Supervised methods such as SSC [ 33 ] and UAFL [ 34 ] improve unaligned HSR by learning spatial-spectral features from synthesized inputs and clean high-resolution references, which are realistically hardly available. Their training conditions specify fixed degradation, spectral sampling, and scale factor, making transfer to native RGB-HSI camera pairs with noise and different sensor responses challenging.
This motivates estimating cross-camera alignment and radiometric differences directly from the acquired images. CMF-GSA-wg [ 9 ] addresses this challenge by transferring RGB details based on registration confidence. However, its single-pass fusion relies on low-resolution data in unreliable regions and has limited ability to suppress noise.
blocks.zh:
SSC[33]和UAFL[34]等监督方法通过从合成投入中学习空间光谱特征和清洁高分辨率参考,改进了不协调的HSR,这些都实际上几乎没有。 他们的训练条件具体规定了固定降解、光谱取样和尺度系数,从而向原生的RGB-HSI相机对位转移,产生噪音和不同的传感器反应具有挑战性。
这促使人们直接从获得的图像中估算跨相机对齐和辐射度差。 CMF-GSA-wg [9]通过根据注册信心转让RGB细节来解决这一挑战. 然而,它的单路聚变依赖于不可靠的区域的低分辨率数据,抑制噪音的能力有限.

blocks.en:
Building on confidence-aware detail transfer, we introduce SHARPnP ,
an interpretable, flexible model that couples registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided HSR from noisy, unaligned camera measurements with no clean reference. We adapt a pretrained registration model, CrossRAFT [ 37 ] , by backpropagating a cross-view loss through a fixed fusion module. This lets the quality of the fused estimate inform the flow update. Temporal and recorrupted pairs provide self-supervision on noisy inputs with no clean high-resolution references, in order to limit flow variability caused by noise.
At test time, SHARPnP calibrates cross-camera radiometry and refines residual alignment.
Plug-and-play (PnP) fusion weights RGB guidance through a pixel-wise alignment confidence and reuses a frozen pretrained denoiser. Where the warp is uncertain, the estimate relies more on the HSI observation and the denoising prior.
An efficient frozen pretrained RGB denoiser [ 23 ] applies that prior to spectral groups, allowing it to operate across different spectral grids. Our contributions are:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Single-image methods such as ESSAformer [ 31 ] recover structure from the HSI alone. RGB guidance supplies additional spatial detail and introduces the need to establish correspondence between views. HSIFN [ 11 ] introduces REAL for evaluating guided HSR from unaligned ground-level views. In this setting, SSC [ 33 ] improves flow estimation and spatial-spectral aggregation, while UAFL [ 34 ] reconstructs abundance maps using deformable aggregation and cross-attention. SA-RFM [ 32 ] couples registration and fusion through Riemannian flow matching, using multispectral gradients to preserve structural boundaries.
blocks.zh: 单像方法,如ESSAformer [31] 单从HSI回收结构. RGB指导提供了额外的空间细节,并引入了在观点之间建立对应关系的必要性. HSIFN [11]从不协调的地面观点引入了对指导性HSR的评价现实. 在此情况下,SSC[33]改进了流量估计和空间-光谱聚合,而UAFL[34]则利用变形聚合和交叉注意重建丰度图. SA-RFM[32]夫妇通过里曼流匹配进行登记和聚变,使用多光谱梯度来保存结构边界.

blocks.en: Unsupervised fusion methods can infer cross-sensor relationships from the observations. For example, u 2 u^{2} -MDN [ 25 ] relates modalities through shared representations and mutual information, while BUSIFusion [ 14 ] estimates degradation parameters and reconstructs the HSI from a single image pair. A complementary question is how much high-resolution spectral information is needed. SparseHSR [ 35 ] studies how the spectral coverage of sparse high-resolution VIS-NIR guidance affects reconstruction from spectrally complete low-resolution HSI.
blocks.zh: 无监督的聚变方法可以从观测中推断出跨传感器的关系. 例如,u 2 u^{2} - MDN [25] 通过共享的表示和相互的信息涉及模式,而BUSIFusion [14] 则估计降解参数,并从一个图像对重建HSI. 一个补充的问题是需要多少高分辨率光谱信息。 SparseHSR [35] 研究稀疏的高分辨率VIS-NIR制导的光谱覆盖范围如何影响从光谱完全低分辨率HSI的重建.

blocks.en: When the measurements leave the reconstruction underdetermined, denoising priors help regularize the estimate. Plug-and-play restoration incorporates denoisers into iterative inverse-problem solvers, as in DPIR [ 29 ] , and Picone et al. [ 23 ] explore spectral grouping to reuse RGB denoisers on hyperspectral data. Noisy observations can also supply supervision when clean references are scarce. Noise2Noise [ 13 ] learns from repeated noisy observations, and GR2R [ 19 ] constructs training views from a single measurement under a specified noise model.
blocks.zh: 当测量结果没有确定重建时,取消前科有助于使估计数正规化。 插件和游戏修复将denoisers纳入迭代反向问题解析器,如DPIR [29],Picone等人. [23] 探索光谱分组,在超光谱数据上再利用RGB denoisers. 噪音观测也可以在清洁参考材料很少时提供监督。 噪音2 Noise [13] 从反复的噪音观测中吸取教训,GR2R [19] 在指定的噪音模型下从单一测量中构建培训视图.

blocks.en: 5.1 Controlled reconstruction on REAL
blocks.zh: 5.1 实际控制下的重建

blocks.en:
REAL is composed of genuinely unaligned HSI views, from which the benchmark constructs RGB guidance by spectral projection and LR-HSI by blur/downsampling [ 11 , 34 ] . Its 31 bands span 400 to 700 nm. We use the official ten test scenes and the retained fitting split of 47 scenes. The benchmark blur is the 8 × 8 8\times 8 Gaussian with width 3 and an upper-left sampling phase. We report mean bandwise PSNR and SSIM, mean spectral angle (SAM, in degrees), and global RMSE. Reproduced metrics follow the training/testing protocol of [ 34 ] .
For the noisy cases, independent Gaussian noise of standard deviation 5 / 255 5/255 or 10 / 255 10/255 is added to LR-HSI with a fixed dataset-indexed realization. Geometry and radiometric fitting use noisy observations.
blocks.zh:
REAL由真正不协调的HSI观点组成,基准通过光谱投影构建RGB导线,LR-HSI通过模糊/下取样[11,34]. 其31个波段跨度400至700nm. 我们使用正式的10个测试场景 以及47个场景中保留下来的配角 基准模糊是8×8 8\times 8 Gaussian,宽度3,为左上角采样阶段. 我们报告指波段PSNR和SSIM,指光谱角度(SAM,以度计),以及全球RMSE。 根据[34]的训练/试验协议复制的衡量标准。
对于吵闹的病例,在LR-HSI中加入了标准偏差5 / 255 5/255或 10 / 255 10/255的独立高斯噪音,并带有固定的数据集索引实现. 几何学和辐射度仪的配位使用噪音观测。

blocks.en:
We reevaluate Bicubic, CMF-GSA, HSIFN, SSC and UAFL under the training/testing protocol of [ 34 ] , together with published SISR and fusion evaluations ported from the same source.
On noisy cases, there was no direct SOTA to compare with, as the aforementioned ones propagate the noise with the signal, so we create a sequential denoise-then-fuse benchmark using the same DRUNet mechanism followed by either SSC or UAFL, dubbed as DRU-SSC and DRU-UAFL, respectively.
These controls test the practical alternative of denoising before fusion.
blocks.zh:
根据[34]的培训/试验协议,我们重新评价Bicubic、CMF-GSA、HSIFN、SSC和UAFL,以及同一来源的已公布的SISR和聚变评价。
在吵闹的案例中,没有直接的SOTA来比较,因为上述的SOTA用信号传播噪音,所以我们利用同样的DRUNet机制,然后使用SSC或UAFL(分别被称作DRU-SSC和DRU-UAFL)来建立连续的denoise-when-fuse基准。
这些控制测试了在核聚变前发音的实际选择.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that the retained SHARPnP configurations exceed the supervised baselines on all four metrics at each scale. At 4 × 4\times , CrossRAFT-based reconstruction reaches 43.37 dB versus 41.91 dB for UAFL. At 8 × 8\times , reconstruction reaches 37.38 dB versus UAFL’s 37.14 dB and improves all four means over UAFL. At 16 × 16\times , CrossRAFT-based reconstruction reaches 32.36 dB and 3.125 ∘ SAM versus 31.89 dB and 3.784 ∘ for UAFL. The retained configurations thus extend reconstruction gains across three spatial sampling regimes.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,保留的SHARPnP配置超过每个尺度上所有四个度量的受监督基线。 在4×4\时,CrossRAFT的重建达到43.37 dB,而UAFL则达到41.91 dB. 在8×8时,重建达到37.38 dB, 相对于UAFL的37.14 dB, 在16 × 16\时,CrossRAFT的重建达到32.36 dB和3.125 → SAM对31.89 dB和3.784 → UAFL. 因此,保留的配置将重建收益扩展到三个空间取样系统。

blocks.en: The direct supervised baselines deteriorate substantially under added HSI noise ( Tab. 3 ). Denoising their inputs is a much stronger comparator than direct noisy inference: DRU-UAFL reaches 39.21/37.17 dB at the two noise levels. SHARPnP reaches 39.33/37.25 dB and improves all four displayed metrics over both DRU baselines. Its RMSE is 0.01185/0.01512 and SAM is 2.736 ∘ /3.375 ∘ . These results show that the benefit extends beyond inserting a denoiser before an existing fusion network.

blocks.en: In the matched clean 4 × 4\times control, replacing DRUNet by identity reduces PSNR from 43.37 to 41.83 dB ( Tab. 4 ). Other pretrained denoisers and Haar shrinkage remain usable but give lower accuracy at the tested settings. This supports reusing a capable pretrained prior rather than attributing the entire result to calibration or RGB fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在匹配的清洁4×4\时间控制中,用身份取代DRUNet将PSNR从43.37降至41.83 dB(Tab. 4). 其他经过预先训练的德诺瓦人和哈尔萎缩剂仍然可以使用,但在测试的设置中给予的精度较低. 这支持重新使用一个经过预先训练的能手,而不是将整个结果归结为校准或RGB忠诚.

blocks.en: Table 5 isolates residual registration and RGB-guidance strength under the final clean 4 × 4\times SHARPnP configuration. Residual correction improves PSNR by 0.54 dB at 0.1 × 0.1\times guidance and by 1.7 dB at the retained strength. Without residual correction, stronger guidance reduces PSNR by 0.94 dB and worsens all four mean metrics. With corrected geometry, it improves PSNR by 0.245 dB and improves SSIM and RMSE, but increases SAM. Adding directional VTV then improves all four metrics in every scene, reaching 43.37 dB and SAM 1.595 ∘ 1.595^{\circ} . These results demonstrate the complementary effects of correspondence correction, detail transfer and spatial regularization. For more details in the implementation see SM.

blocks.en: We acquire sequences of a stationary scene with objects at different depths using an Ultris SR5 compact snapshot HSI camera and a Raspberry Pi HQ RGB camera. The HSI contains 51 VIS-NIR bands from 450 to 850 nm at 8 nm intervals; its first 31 bands span 450 to 690 nm. We use 480 ms exposures for higher-SNR observations and 30 ms exposures for a 10 fps hyperspectral video with stronger sensor noise. Measurements are dark/flat corrected, without synthetic degradation or added noise. Temporal Noise2Noise pairs adapt CrossRAFT, while radiometry and residual alignment are fitted from the measurements. Each exposure uses 70 adaptation, 10 validation and 10 diagnostic frames, without clean HR references.

Figure 4 compares the native reconstructions. The 480 ms acquisition provides stronger signal, although still noisy, whereas the 30 ms video demonstrates the deterioration caused by low-SNR snapshot imaging. SSC and UAFL propagate measurement noise and lose fine target structure. CMF-GSA-wg transfers RGB details but retains visible noise and locally smooth regions. It reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands with the same frozen denoiser, whereas the transferred neural baselines operate on the 31-band VIS subset. blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SHARPnP, a self-supervised plug-and-play framework for RGB-guided
hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned camera measurements.
SHARPnP needs no high-resolution hyperspectral references. It adapts a
pretrained registration model through reconstruction feedback and fuses
calibrated RGB guidance with a frozen denoising prior. It sets a new state of
the art on REAL dataset, surpassing supervised fusion methods at all scales and
reaching 43.37 dB at 4 × 4\times versus 41.91 dB for the strongest baseline.
Self-supervised fine-tuning on noisy pairs extends it to noisy inputs, where it
reaches 39.33 dB at σ = 5 / 255 \sigma=5/255 , nearly 7 dB above direct supervised
fusion. On a native snapshot rig, it reconstructs all 51 VIS–NIR bands. A relevant finding of this study is that NIR information contributes to the reconstruction of spatial details, even in regions where RGB guidance is limited. This observation motivates future work on improving spectral consistency in the NIR range, ensuring that reconstructed details remain faithful to the underlying spectral information. Additionally, we aim to extend SHARPnP to real-time hyperspectral video super-resolution by accelerating its test-time optimization, enabling more efficient reconstruction of dynamic scenes and moving objects.

blocks.en:
In this section, we expand on the real native RGB-HSI experimental section by a quantitative analysis and an additional real native scene.
In Section D.1 ,
we revisit the scenes from Section 5.3 of the main paper at the two exposure times, 480 ms and 30 ms, and add a quantitative analysis of their results with no clean high-resolution reference.
In Section D.2 , we add results on a different real native scene, which was used in [ 9 ] , while considering the same qualitative and quantitative analysis style as our data from Section 5.3 of the main paper.
blocks.zh:
在这一节中,我们通过定量分析和额外的真实本土场景来扩展真正的本土RGB-HSI实验部分.
在D.1节,
我们从主要论文第5.3节重温了两次曝光时480毫秒和30毫秒的场景,并增加了对其结果的定量分析,没有干净的高分辨率参考.
在D.2节中,我们添加了不同真实原生场景的结果,在[9]中使用了这些结果,同时考虑了与我们主要论文第5.3节的数据相同的定性和定量分析风格.

blocks.en:
Neither acquisition provides a clean high-resolution HSI reference.
On the high-resolution grid, we rely on the controlled spatial and spectral targets that are present in the different scenes in order to inspect how well each method recovers spatial and spectral details in the final super-resolved outputs.
As for reported full-image metrics, the analysis is performed on the low-resolution HSI grid.
In particular, we blur and downsample each super-resolved output to the observed low-resolution HSI grid and compare it with temporally averaged HSI observations of the same scene. This is done in order to reduce the effect of noise of a single observed HSI frame and focus more on spatial and spectral structures.
blocks.zh:
两次收购都没有提供干净的高分辨率HSI参考.
在高分辨率网格上,我们依靠不同场景中存在的可控空间和光谱目标,以检查每种方法在最终超解输出中如何恢复空间和光谱细节.
至于所报告的全图像测量,分析是在低分辨率的HSI网格上进行的。
特别是,我们模糊和下取样每个超解输出到观测到的低分辨率HSI网格,并与同一场景的时间平均HSI观测数据进行比较. 这样做是为了减少单个观测到的HSI框架的噪声效应,并更加注重空间和光谱结构.

blocks.en:
We report RMSE and SAM separately over the 31 VIS bands and the 20 NIR bands. We also report our so-called neighborhood SAM ( N-SAM ) and Spectralon variation ( S-Var ).
For N-SAM , we select a small neighborhood (patch) inside each ColorChecker square used in the experiment and one on the white Spectralon surface. We then average the spectra in each neighborhood and compute the angle between the measured and reconstructed visible spectra, giving one angle per neighborhood. We report the median of these angles.
For S-Var , we select a uniform neighborhood on the white Spectralon surface, which is expected to be flat and smooth. We compute the standard deviation of the pixel intensities in this neighborhood to measure how much the reconstructed white surface varies from pixel to pixel.
blocks.zh:
我们分别就31个VIS频段和20个国家清单报告RMSE和SAM。 我们还报告我们所谓的邻居SAM(N-SAM)和Spectralon变异(S-Val).
对于N-SAM,我们在每个实验中使用的彩色检查器广场内选择一个小街区(patch),并在白色的Spectralon表面选择一个. 然后我们平均每个街区的光谱,计算测量到的与重建的可见光谱之间的角度,给每个街区一个角度. 我们报告这些角度的中位数。
对S-Var来说,我们在白色的Spectralon表面选择一个统一的街区,预计是平整和光滑的. 我们计算这附近像素强度的标准偏差,以衡量重建后的白色表面在像素和像素之间有多大差异.

In general, SHARPnP has the cleanest trade-off between sharpness and overshooting around the spatial profile.
For instance, at 650 nm, Bicubic spreads the transition from bright to dark over about six pixels at both exposures. SHARPnP narrows it to about four pixels (Figure S4 ). SSC-S gives an even sharper edge, but at 30 ms its intensity overshoots the edge by about 24% of the bright-to-dark intensity difference. The corresponding overshoot for SHARPnP is below 1%.

blocks.en:
Figure S7 shows a qualitative analysis of the results.
In the visible domain, we can see where RGB detail helps and where it can introduce artifacts.
SSC-S and UAFL, transferred from supervised training on the REAL data, show poor generalization to real native RGB-HSI sensor setup. For instance, the overall images propagate some noise, show blurry and poorly reconstructed areas, propagate what looks like artifacts from the unregistered RGB guide (partly visible in the upper-right crop showing the Spectralon edge), show faint horizontal lines crossing the Spectralon edge and extra contours along the lower edge of the whiteboard, and show larger errors in the RMSE maps.
CMF-GSA-wg recovers a cleaner image with more details, but it provides limited noise reduction and a confidence-gated strategy that falls back on the original low-resolution HSI in unreliable regions (partly visible in the upper-right crop showing the Spectralon edge).
SHARPnP gives a cleaner Spectralon edge and recovers more distinct details and strokes, including the gray steps and inner rings on the small target, as well as the lines of the circular target.
blocks.zh:
图S7对结果进行了定性分析。
在可见域中,我们可以看到RGB细节的帮助和可以引入文物的地方.
SSC-S和UAFL从关于真实数据的监督培训中转移出来,显示一般化程度差,无法真正实现RGB-HSI传感器配置。 例如,总体图像传播一些噪音,显示模糊和重建不良的地区,传播未注册的RGB指南(部分可见于显示Spectralon边缘的右上方作物)中的文物,显示沿白板下方边缘横跨Spectralon边缘的微弱水平线和额外的轮廓,并在RMSE地图中显示较大的错误.
CMF-GSA-wg回收了更清洁的图像,并提供了更多细节,但是它提供了有限的降噪量,以及一种在不可靠的区域(部分可见于显示斯佩克特拉龙边缘的上层作物)回落于原低分辨率HSI的置信策略.
SHARPnP给出了更清洁的Spectralon边缘,并恢复了更清晰的细节和中风,包括小目标上的灰色阶梯和内环,以及圆形目标线.

blocks.en:
Figure S8 shows the reconstructions at 802 nm. We compare Bicubic, CMF-GSA-wg and SHARPnP, the three methods that reconstruct all 51 bands.
The writing visible in the RGB guide also appears in the CMF-GSA-wg reconstruction, although it is faint or absent in the bicubic NIR crop.
SHARPnP, on the other hand, refines the NIR details and recovers some details with respect to the bicubic, but unlike CMF-GSA-wg, the projection of details from the visible domain is much more suppressed.
blocks.zh:
图S8显示重建时间为802nm. 我们比较了比库比克,CMF-GSA-wg和SHARPnP,这是重建所有51个波段的三种方法.
RGB指南中可见的书写也出现在CMF-GSA-wg重建中,虽然在双立体国家清单报告作物中微弱或缺失.
另一方面,SHARPnP则完善了国家清单报告的细节,并恢复了有关双库的一些细节,但与CMF-GSA-wg不同的是,从可见域对细节的预测被压制得多.

blocks.en: The spectra in Figure S9 come from the blue, green and red ColorChecker patches, as well as the Spectralon, by considering the averaged spectrum of a neighborhood of pixels to reduce the effect of the noise for a single pixel spectrum. These probes are selected because they are controlled elements known for their spectral properties and cover VIS-NIR ranges. SHARPnP acts on all 51 bands and remains close to the reference.
